about.bannerSubtitle: Over a decade of pioneering comprehensive MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) solutions, BIM digitization, and field-proven execution.
overviewParagraphs: Shicons E&C Joint Stock Company is a specialized MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) general contractor, pioneering the design and installation of HVAC, MEP, and high-tech cleanroom systems for FDI factories, international hospitals, and Grade-A office towers.

Guided by our motto “Precision Engineering — Absolute Safety — Sustainable Partnership”, Shicons integrates BIM Revit MEP LOD 400 digitization across site management to optimize costs and guarantee schedule precision.
about.visionDesc: To become the region's leading MEP contractor in high-tech manufacturing, semiconductor cleanrooms, and smart commercial towers, trusted by global partners.
about.missionDesc: To deliver safe, reliable, and energy-efficient MEP systems while cultivating a professional engineering environment that empowers Vietnamese talent.

coreValues.title: Precision
coreValues.desc: Engineering rigor in every joint, cable tray, and commissioning test.

coreValues.title: Safety
coreValues.desc: Safety First — Zero LTI across all project sites.

about.hseTitle: Commitment to Workplace Safety & Engineering Quality
about.hseDesc: At Shicons E&C, occupational safety and site engineering discipline are not merely regulations—they are the lifeblood and honor of our company.

manufacturing.bannerSubtitle: 100% control of our MEP supply chain with a 10,000 m² fabrication plant in Binh Duong Province, mastering precision manufacturing.
manufacturing.factoryTitle: 10,000 m² Fabrication Plant – Schedule & Quality Control
factoryParagraphs: To optimize schedules and ensure technical consistency for turnkey MEP contracts, Shicons E&C invested in a 10,000 m² MEP equipment and accessory manufacturing plant in Binh Duong Province.

The facility is equipped with automated fabrication lines: CNC laser/plasma cutters, Auto-Line V TDC/TDF duct forming lines, continuous punching machines, and an international-standard electrical switchboard assembly & testing workshop.

hvac-system.shortDesc: Design & installation of water/air-cooled Chillers, smart VRV/VRF systems, and high-efficiency conditioned air distribution.
hvac-system.fullDesc: Shicons E&C delivers comprehensive HVAC Systems for industrial plants, commercial developments, and Grade-A office towers. Our engineers master chilled-water hydraulic balancing, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), and Chiller Plant COP optimization.
features: High-COP water-cooled and air-cooled Water Chiller systems
Smart inverter VRV / VRF central air conditioning for commercial towers
Hydraulic balancing, chilled-air distribution, and BMS integration

subSystems.name: VRV / VRF Central Air Conditioning
subSystems.desc: Superior energy efficiency with flexible multi-zone temperature control

subSystems.name: BMS Energy Monitoring Integration

hospital-cleanroom.shortDesc: Sterile operating theatre solutions featuring Laminar Flow ceilings, HEPA H14 filtration, and centralized medical gas systems.
hospital-cleanroom.fullDesc: Sterile surgical suites and ICUs demand absolute precision. Shicons E&C designs and builds positive-pressure Laminar Airflow cleanrooms with HEPA H14 filtration, eliminating cross-contamination risks under strict healthcare protocols.
features: Laminar Flow ceiling plenums with HEPA H14 filtration for absolute sterility
Strict positive pressure, humidity, and temperature control for OR suites
Centralized O2, Medical Air, N2O, and Vacuum gas systems with automated pressure monitoring

subSystems.name: Sterile Laminar Airflow Ceilings
subSystems.desc: Uniform 0.25–0.35 m/s velocity with 99.995% filtration efficiency at 0.3 µm

factory-mep-cleanroom.fullDesc: Shicons E&C is a trusted partner of global FDI manufacturers. We deliver complex industrial MEP infrastructure from 22kV/35kV substations and high-capacity Busway distribution to ultra-clean microelectronics and pharmaceutical cleanrooms.

Microelectronics and pharmaceutical cleanrooms with strict particulate control
Industrial compressed air, RO/EDI purified water, and WFI sanitary piping

ventilation-smoke-exhaust.shortDesc: Basement Jetfan ventilation, corridor smoke exhaust, and stairwell pressurization systems engineered for maximum life-safety compliance.
ventilation-smoke-exhaust.fullDesc: Protecting occupant evacuation during fire emergencies is the core mission of smoke-control ventilation. Shicons E&C provides integrated Jetfan basement ventilation, fire-rated smoke exhaust ductwork, and stairwell pressurization systems.

Fire-rated smoke exhaust ductwork certified for 300°C for 2 hours

proj-intel-vietnam.name: INTEL VIETNAM SEMICONDUCTOR ASSEMBLY & TEST FACILITY
proj-intel-vietnam.location: Saigon Hi-Tech Park (SHTP), Thu Duc City
proj-intel-vietnam.description: One of Southeast Asia's largest semiconductor assembly and test facilities operated by Intel Corporation. Shicons E&C executed auxiliary MEP packages, process piping, and high-tech cleanroom maintenance.
technicalHighlights: Installed ultra-pure CDA compressed air and orbital-welded SS 316L sanitary piping
Precision air conditioning maintaining ±0.5°C temperature and humidity tolerance
Redundant UPS and continuous backup generator systems for zero power interruption
100% BIM Revit MEP Level of Development (LOD) 400 coordination
proj-intel-vietnam.challengesAndSolutions: Strict Vibration Criteria and ESD protection requirements for semiconductor manufacturing. Shicons E&C implemented dedicated equipotential grounding below 0.5 Ohm.

proj-bel-vietnam.name: BEL VIETNAM CHEESE MANUFACTURING PLANT
proj-bel-vietnam.location: Song Than 3 Industrial Park, Binh Duong Province
proj-bel-vietnam.description: European-standard cheese production plant of Bel Group in Vietnam. Shicons E&C delivered design and installation of power distribution, 22kV substation, and HVAC infrastructure for The Laughing Cow production lines.
technicalHighlights: Installed explosion-proof Schneider Electric substation and Busway distribution
HACCP-compliant cold storage temperature and humidity control systems
Steam and chilled-water piping insulated with anti-condensation PIR foam
proj-bel-vietnam.challengesAndSolutions: Stringent international food-hygiene compliance. Food-grade stainless steel piping and cleanroom ventilation were executed to exact tolerances.

proj-t3-tan-son-nhat.name: TAN SON NHAT INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT TERMINAL 3
proj-t3-tan-son-nhat.location: Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City
proj-t3-tan-son-nhat.description: A flagship national infrastructure project expanding Tan Son Nhat International Airport capacity. Shicons E&C executes complex MEP packages, basement Jetfan smoke exhaust ductwork, and terminal electrical infrastructure.
technicalHighlights: Basement Jetfan smoke extraction rated at 300°C for 2 hours
BIM Revit MEP LOD 400 coordination resolving complex arched-roof spatial clashes
Fire-rated distribution switchboards and cable trays meeting international codes
proj-t3-tan-son-nhat.challengesAndSolutions: Massive installation volume on an aggressive handover schedule. Shicons E&C deployed off-site modular prefabrication and rolling site installation.

proj-an-sinh-hospital.name: AN SINH HOSPITAL STERILE OPERATING THEATRES & IVF CLEANROOMS
proj-an-sinh-hospital.location: 10 Tran Huy Lieu, Ward 11, Phu Nhuan District, HCMC
proj-an-sinh-hospital.description: High-tech surgical suites and IVF embryology cleanrooms at An Sinh General Hospital. Shicons E&C designed and built positive-pressure cleanroom HVAC, Laminar Flow HEPA H14 ceilings, and centralized medical gas systems.
technicalHighlights: Laminar Flow HEPA H14 ceiling plenums achieving Class 100 sterility
Centralized O2, Vacuum, N2O, and Medical Air compliant with HTM 02-01
Medical IT isolation transformers with automated ground-fault alarms
proj-an-sinh-hospital.challengesAndSolutions: Zero-vibration and absolute sterility requirements for IVF micromanipulators. Shicons E&C installed independent AHU units with custom hydraulic vibration isolators.

proj-dhg-pharma.name: DHG PHARMA HIGH-TECH PHARMACEUTICAL FACTORY
proj-dhg-pharma.location: Tan Phu Thanh Industrial Park, Hau Giang Province
proj-dhg-pharma.description: The largest Japan-GMP and EU-GMP pharmaceutical manufacturing complex in the Mekong Delta. Shicons E&C delivered particulate-controlled cleanrooms, sanitary WFI water loops, and strict thermal-humidity HVAC systems.
technicalHighlights: Closed-loop SS 316L WFI water system electropolished to Ra < 0.4 µm
15–30 Pa cascading cleanroom pressure differentials preventing cross-contamination
24/7 real-time SCADA BMS monitoring of temperature, humidity, and pressure
proj-dhg-pharma.challengesAndSolutions: Dual compliance with Japan-GMP and EU-GMP validation audits. Shicons E&C passed Testing & Commissioning at 100% on the very first inspection.

proj-hanacos-vietnam.name: HANACOS VIETNAM COSMETICS MANUFACTURING FACTORY
proj-hanacos-vietnam.client: Hanacos Vietnam Co., Ltd. (Korean Tech Transfer)
proj-hanacos-vietnam.location: Tan Binh Expanded Industrial Park, Ho Chi Minh City
proj-hanacos-vietnam.description: Leading southern cosmetics and personal-care plant built with Korean technology transfer. Shicons E&C served as turnkey MEP and cGMP cleanroom contractor for all manufacturing workshops.
technicalHighlights: ASEAN cGMP cleanrooms equipped with ceiling FFU HEPA filtration units
Two-stage RO purified water plant meeting microbiological standards
Moisture- and chemical-resistant Cleanroom LED lighting solutions
proj-hanacos-vietnam.challengesAndSolutions: Zoning pressure differentials between chemical compounding and sterile packaging rooms. Shicons E&C deployed automated VAV dampers for exact airflow control.

post-1.title: Shicons E&C Celebrates Topping-Out & Phase 1 MEP Handover at Pegatron Plant
post-1.excerpt: Meeting tight schedule milestones, the Shicons E&C site team successfully energized the 22kV substation and commissioned the main workshop HVAC systems.
post-1.content: On October 15, 2024, at Dinh Vu Economic Zone (Hai Phong), Shicons E&C joined Pegatron Corporation and supervision consultants to celebrate the topping-out and Phase 1 MEP handover. The project achieved 100% Zero LTI safety compliance under HSE standards, demonstrating Shicons E&C's project discipline.
post-1.author: Shicons Communications Team

post-2.title: Shicons E&C Awarded Turnkey MEP Contract for Capital One Financial Tower
post-2.excerpt: The VND 280+ billion contract marks a major milestone reinforcing Shicons E&C's standing in international Grade-A commercial towers.
post-2.content: Following a rigorous international tender, Capital Land officially awarded the turnkey MEP design-and-build contract to Shicons E&C. Targeting LEED Gold certification, the project incorporates breakthrough energy-saving MEP solutions.
post-2.author: Tendering & Planning Dept.

post-3.title: Applying BIM Revit MEP LOD 400 to Resolve MEP Clashes in Tight Spaces
post-3.excerpt: Field lessons from Shicons E&C's Engineering & Design Team on 3D spatial coordination cutting on-site installation time by 15%.
post-3.content: Modern industrial facilities pack dense ductwork, cable trays, fire sprinklers, and process piping into tight ceiling plenums. Using BIM at LOD 400 enables Shicons E&C engineers to extract exact Shop Drawings down to every flange and eliminate 100% of clashes before fabrication.
post-3.author: M.Eng. Nguyen Hoang Nam – Technical Director

post-4.title: HSE Safety Workshop: 'Safety First' Culture Across All Shicons Project Sites
post-4.excerpt: The 'Safety First – Zero Accident' campaign rolled out nationwide with 100% participation from engineers and site crews.
post-4.content: At Shicons E&C, occupational safety is not a slogan—it is our core culture. Executive leadership conducted site inspections and recognized project teams maintaining 100% Zero LTI records nationwide.
post-4.author: HSE & Environment Dept.

job-1.title: MEP Project Manager
description: Lead full schedule, quality, budget, and HSE safety execution for site MEP packages.
Coordinate directly with Clients, Supervision Consultants, and Subcontractors to resolve technical issues.
Oversee material take-offs, detailed master schedules, and method statement approvals.
Direct energization, Testing & Commissioning (T&C), and final client handover.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Electrical, MEP, or HVAC Engineering.
Valid Class I or Class II Construction Supervision License.
At least 3 years in an equivalent role on FDI factory or high-rise tower projects.
Strong English communication skills for technical coordination.
benefits: Competitive salary + attractive project completion bonuses.
Full accommodation and travel allowances for remote sites.
Clear career path toward Regional Project Director.

job-2.title: BIM / Revit MEP Design & Coordination Engineer
description: Develop 3D Revit MEP models for HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Protection at LOD 350–400.
Run Clash Detection in Navisworks and propose spatial routing resolutions.
Generate detailed Shop Drawings for off-site fabrication and field installation.
Coordinate with site teams to update As-built BIM models.
requirements: Proficiency in Revit MEP, Navisworks Manage, and AutoCAD.
Solid knowledge of MEP codes and standards (TCVN, QCVN, ASHRAE, NFPA).
Strong teamwork, attention to detail, and accountability for drawing quality.
benefits: Professional workspace equipped with high-spec graphic workstations.
Sponsored international BIM Management training certifications.

job-3.title: Site Electrical & ELV Engineer
description: Supervise site installation of MV/LV power, cable ladders/trays, Busway, and lighting systems.
Enforce electrical safety and workplace HSE compliance across assigned zones.
Inspect incoming materials against approved specifications and submittals.
Prepare daily inspection and acceptance documentation with consultants.
requirements: College or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or Automation.
Strong ability to read design drawings and Shop Drawings.
Diligent and resilient under fast-paced site schedules.
benefits: Monthly site, meal, and phone allowances.
Full social & health insurance per Vietnamese Labor Law.
Direct mentorship from senior MEP specialists.
